description: Real Honk proofs for the on-chain CKKS verifiers. `parties` are N C1-CKKS (pk_generation_ckks_ps5) proofs, one per committee member, in ascending party order — the CkksPkVerifier input. `c7` is one decrypted_shares_aggregation_ckks proof — the CkksDecryptionVerifier input. Regenerate with scripts/ckks-onchain-verifier-fixtures.sh 5.
